sources.title: Generalist AI Releases GEN-1.5: A Robot Foundation Model That Learns ...
sources.snippet: Generalist AI has released GEN-1.5, a robot foundation model that learns a new physical task from a single demonstration. Drop 3-12 seconds of sensorimotor data into its 30-second context window, and the robot performs the task.
